source_failure.failed_axis: A scalar history-latent correction preserved the backbone and calibrated abstention but did not improve held-out prediction beyond simpler frozen correctors.

preserved_components.novelty_boundary: Known frozen side-network and feedback-control mechanisms; not claimed as new.
Selective rejection is known and the local B3 implementation already passed calibration gates.
Free-running and train-sample alignment are known; gradients remain isolated to the adapter.

hypothesized_new_combination.target_specific_role: Represent history error as spatially localized consecutive-frame residual features and inject corrections at multiple frozen U-Net depths instead of one scalar latent gain.
Learn execute direction and coverage from randomized correction versus no-correction rollout outcomes, with development meta-loss alignment and a separate promotion holdout.

implementation_contract.identity_rule: Every side projection is zero initialized; enabling the module before training must reproduce the official checkpoint bit-for-bit within the existing zero-dose tolerance.
implementation_contract.routing_rule: The side feature direction is learned by the adapter. The use head alone owns execute versus abstain; confidence cannot substitute for use probability.
implementation_contract.benefit_rule: For each development rollout state, evaluate shared-seed negative, zero, and positive adapter doses. Supervise use from whether the best nonzero arm beats zero, and supervise direction only when a nonzero arm is beneficial.
implementation_contract.gradient_rule: Only history_corrector parameters may enter the optimizer; the checkpoint verifier must reject any changed official tensor.

forbidden: episode identity as a router feature
relabeling a harmful nonzero arm as useful because its training loss decreased
data_admission_gate.failure_action: Do not train the candidate; expand development probes or return to retrieval.

screen_budget.batch_size_tuning_rule: Increase to two only after an eight-rank optimizer-step smoke remains below 90 percent of physical memory on every rank.

promotion_gate: all official checkpoint tensors remain unchanged
candidate beats A0, B2, and B3 on mean L1, final-interaction L1, and horizon slope
candidate wins at least two of three paired seeds against each comparator
action response remains at least 0.9 times A0
harmful routing rate is at most 0.1
at least one held-out context requires correction and at least one requires abstention
only a full pass licenses a separate 512-step plan
claim_boundary: This is a literature-grounded structural composition and falsifiable target-side candidate. No component or combination is a publication-level novelty or general model-improvement claim until independent multi-context confirmation passes.
